description: Editable search catalogue. Query strings are starting points for review, not validated search recipes. This file is not yet connected to the running agent.

editing.select_by: Purpose ID, then query ID. Select one query at a time; do not execute every alternative automatically.
editing.syntax: Replace {variable} placeholders with literal trip or place values before URL encoding the complete query. Missing values must be supplied; never send unresolved placeholders.
editing.change_queries: Edit the template strings or add alternatives. Keep IDs stable when changing wording.
editing.query_vs_instruction: Templates contain search terms only. Instructions about extraction, citations, output language and JSON belong in the research prompt.
editing.source_validation: Search operators help discovery. Verify the final URL and matching entity after opening the result. Do not treat a search snippet as a verified provider rating.

variables.place: Destination city or region, e.g. Hoi An.
variables.exact_place: Specific entity whose listing or reviews are needed, e.g. Hoi An Ancient Town. Do not silently replace a city with an attraction.
variables.location: City, region or country needed to distinguish the entity; avoid repeating its name.
variables.interest: One travel interest, e.g. beaches. Research another interest in a separate query when needed.
variables.traveler_constraint: One relevant constraint, e.g. young children or wheelchair access.
variables.review_topic: One concern to investigate, e.g. crowds, accessibility or ticket prices.

discover_destinations.description: Find candidate places within the requested country, before evaluating the full trip fit.

assess_family_suitability.description: Find practical evidence about one destination and one traveler constraint.

find_google_listing.description: Resolve a specific place to a Google Maps listing. A city may have no applicable aggregate rating.

find_tripadvisor_listing.description: Resolve the requested entity to a Tripadvisor listing; distinguish destination guides from rated attractions, hotels and businesses.

find_positive_experiences.description: Find reported highlights. Read mixed reviews too; this search alone cannot establish overall sentiment.

find_drawbacks.description: Investigate specific limitations without interpreting complaint-focused results as representative sentiment.
